title: Prospect velocity gap prioritizer and automated fallback triage
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Objective: build an automated prioritizer that converts continuous market signals about new model entrants and provider behavior into ranked operational actions (alerts, canary rollouts, or immediate fallback mappings). The focus is on combining velocity signals (rate of new model releases, latency/economics shifts in regions), quality deltas from small-context microbenchmarks, and infra affinity (quantization/hardware compatibility) to produce an ordered ‘stop-gap’ plan for SRE/Capacity/Product teams.

Why this ticket: current monitoring surfaces raw model availability and latency spikes but lacks an actionable ranking that balances likelihood of customer disruption, rollback cost, and remediation speed. The prioritizer will reduce manual triage time and enable deterministic automatic fallbacks for high-risk signals.

Scope & deliverables:
- Signal catalog: define and instrument 6 signal types (release velocity, price-discount events, region outage velocity, API contract deltas, quantization mismatch rate, latency dispersion).
- Scoring model: lightweight heuristic that weights signals by customer exposure (top 20% tenants), latency SLA breach probability, and operational rollback cost.
- Prototype alert pipeline: event -> enrich (model metadata & affinity) -> score -> action recommendation. Integrate with existing watchtower alerts and Slack-runbooks.
- Dashboard: compact diffusion map visualizing entrant velocity vs. risk score; ability to filter by region, model family, and customer cohort.
- Runbook & automation: recommended triage actions (notify & watch, canary route, immediate fallback to pinned model) and a PoC auto-fallback for P0 signals.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end prototype that ingests three live feeds (model registry changes, latency telemetry, and pricing events) and emits scored alerts to a test channel.
- Dashboard shows diffusion map and top-10 ranked incidents for last 7 days.
- SRE playbook validated with two runbook playthroughs and sign-off from Reliability PM.
- Clear API for Eng teams to subscribe to ranked alerts for automated rollback wiring.

Primary success metrics:
- Median triage time for emergent model incidents reduced by 40% in pilot tenants.
- False-positive actionable alerts under 10% during pilot.
- Pilot customers preserved application latency SLOs during two injected outage scenarios.

2026-03-09: Draft scoring heuristic v0 shared with Runtime team for feasibility. Runtime asked for an affinity field (quantization_support) in model registry; created ENG dependency. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/218
2026-03-11: Design critique: diffusion map mockups accepted with small UX changes (add cohort switchover slider). Design doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleMockups

2026-03-12: Infra review flagged need for rate-limiting on auto-fallbacks and audit logs for switch events. Added policy item to runbook. Next: implement test channel and wire alert enrichment pipeline.
notes: Risk: scoring may overweight noisy pricing blips; plan to implement debounce and minimum-window thresholds.
Stakeholders: Reliability PM (Sofia Martín) signed up for runbook validation; Sales/CS will be notified for any customer-impacting auto-fallbacks.
Next milestone: deliver working alert pipeline to test channel by 2026-03-19.
